setup: A right triangle has legs [[a]] and [[b]] and hypotenuse [[h]], and the problem gives one reciprocal ratio for an acute angle.

steps.say: The cosine of the angle is the adjacent leg over the hypotenuse, which here is [[a]] over [[h]].
The sine of the angle is the opposite leg over the hypotenuse, which here is [[b]] over [[h]].
Secant, cosecant and cotangent invert the cosine, the sine and the tangent, so the ratio the question wants is the given one turned upside down: its numerator is the side that was the denominator.
